name: Mongolian Nature World Expo
summary: Step into the heart of Mongolia, a land where the landscape feels endless, untamed, and ancient. Traverse vast steppes that stretch to the horizon, where the golden grasses sway under wide-open skies. Explore the rugged beauty of the Altai Mountains, their snow-capped peaks rising sharply above deep valleys and glacier-fed rivers.
